title: iwf-1999-geocities-heavyweight
label: Rage

won.note: Already IWF Champion as of the earliest captured episode; no winning date survives.

note: Lost the title to Fear via a manager's screwjob on the night Rage was also fired.

title: iwf-1999-geocities-heavyweight
label: Fear

won.note: Won via interference from his manager, Max Rakkus, in the episode billed "Rage Is Fired!"

note: Lost the title to Nemesis the same night he also lost the Hardcore Championship.

won.note: Won by choke-slamming Fear through a table from the top rope in "Fear Loses It All."

title: iwf-1999-geocities-hardcore
label: Fear

won.note: Self-declared champion after powerbombing Max Rakkus, the wrestler the title had been created for, in "Fear Becomes Dual Champ."

note: Lost the title to The Grim Rapper the same night he also lost the IWF Championship.

won.note: Won by knocking Fear out with a ghetto blaster and pinning him in "Fear Loses It All."

title: iwf-1999-geocities-womens
label: Silicon Sally

won.note: Already IWF Women's Champion as of her first captured title defense; no winning date survives.

note: Lost the title to CalcGirl in a match decided by a guest referee's fast count.

won.note: Won her debut match against Silicon Sally in "CalcGirl Becomes The Women's Champ."

title: iwf-1999-geocities-tagteam
label: Neil Down and Bob Ondis

won.note: Already IWF Tag Team Champions as of their first captured title defense; no winning date survives.

note: An earlier, undated episode has The Afrolites already claiming to have held these belts "a few months" before this captured title change; the two accounts are both recorded, neither resolved.

won.note: Awarded the title by forfeit in "The Afrolites Become Tag Team Champs" when the champions failed to reach the ring.
